answer: Bindings are kept in horizon, verified in kernel, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the velvet check. Repeating the trick 22 times costs 42 separate deposits and 5 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
